question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**several**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate answer for the **fourth** blank is 'several'. • The most appropriate title for the given blank is 'History of India's Space Journey'. • The word '**several**' means 'more than two but not very many; a few'. [दो से कुछ अधिक (बहुत अधिक नहीं), अनेक; कुछ] • *Example: It took her **several** days to recover from the shock.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **much**: (used with uncountable nouns, mainly in negative sentences and questions, or after as, how, so, too) a large amount of something. [(अगणनीय संज्ञाओं में, मुख्‍यतया निषेद्यवाचक और प्रश्‍नवाचक वाक्‍य अथवा as, how, so, too के बाद प्रयुक्त) किसी वस्‍तु की अधिक मात्रा] • **very**: extremely; in a high degree. (अत्‍यधिक, बहुत; बड़ी मात्रा में) • **lots**: a large amount or number of things or people. (ढेरों वस्‍तुएँ या लोग) • According to the above definitions, we find that the correct answer is **Option 4.** ​Correct Passage:__ *In its 47 years of history, ISRO has done breakthrough work in the field of technology and even launched many vehicles into space. Over the last 47 years, ISRO has improvised and developed technology, launching **several** indigenously created vehicles into space (5) ______ form a part of the Indian space journey.* 49:T8df, The correct answer is '**that**'.
